versions.changelog: Shorter three-essential setup, one scheduling confirmation, and flexible sleep duration with optional independent wake time.

Adds gradual 15/30-minute sleep-time adjustment plans, stage-aware reminders, manual hold/advance/back/pause/cancel controls, local export and audit support, safety boundaries, bilingual examples, and deterministic tests.
Make the authorized daily wind-down reminder the primary coaching loop; clarify goodnight and morning as low-friction data collection for trend analysis.
Declare official OpenClaw runtime requirements and add localized, fail-closed consent handling.
Harden scheduler integration with typed executable/argv requests, shell-disabled execution, explicit capability metadata, validation, and regression tests.
